The plate is square and about 26 cm across, so it works as the ruler.

The rice covers roughly 12 × 11 cm and is piled moderately, about 3 cm high in places. That is about 200–220 g of cooked rice. At about 1.3 kcal/g, that comes to about 270 kcal.

The carrots look roasted, about 5 pieces. Together they weigh roughly 80 g. At about 0.5 kcal/g, plus some oil, that is about 50 kcal.

The total is about 290 g and about 320 kcal.
